title: fix(plugin-grid): a multi-field row conflict lists each field, and a summary column's footer total is formatted as its cells

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:① 表格整行保存遇到 409 冲突、且这一行改了多个字段时,冲突对话框按字段逐行列出(列标题、你的修改、当前值),不再把两个整对象打成原始 JSON;只改一个字段的冲突外观不变。② 列表底部合计行里,汇总字段(`Field.summary`)的合计按它在单元格里的画法格式化:声明了币种(`currencyConfig`)就按货币,否则按声明的 `scale` 位小数;都没声明的保持原样。HotCRM 发票列表的「Paid 230,000」因此读作「230,000.00」,与该列单元格一致。
- 为什么改:① 多字段冲突时对话框只给整行草稿对象,用户看到的是 `{"estimate_hours":61,...}`;#33547 已给对话框加了逐字段列表,表格这条路径还没填。② 合计行的格式化按列类型分支,`summary` 类型落到兜底分支,从不读 `scale`;实测 showcase 服务端返回的汇总字段带 `scale: 2`,缺口在 ui。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@object-ui/plugin-grid` 内部和 `@object-ui/fields` 新增一个导出 `summaryDeclaresCurrency`(单元格本就用它判断汇总字段是否为货币,现在合计行复用同一个判断,不另写格式化器)。货币与否按汇总字段自己的 `currencyConfig`,不看被汇总的源字段类型,这是 spec 的规定,席位已认可。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts` 的 `summaryValueType` 及 `formatSummaryLabel` 里改为调用它的那一行;`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` 的 `buildRowConflict` 新增的 `fields`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerSummaryFieldScale-33542.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditConflictFields-33557.test.tsx`,预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**#33557, a multi-field grid row conflict lists each field.** `buildRowConflict` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` now fills the conflict's `fields` list (#33547's `ConcurrentUpdateFieldConflict`: field, label, your edit, current value) when a row save changed more than one field, labelled by the column header (`columnHeaderOf`, the label the one-field conflict already uses). The dialog then draws one row per field instead of the two whole-map previews. A one-field conflict is built exactly as before.

**#33542, a summary column's footer total is formatted as its cell.** The footer formatter (`formatSummaryLabel` in `useColumnSummary.ts`) chooses its arm by the column type, and a `summary` column fell to the plain default, which never reads `scale`. A new `summaryValueType` routes a summary into the arm the list cell draws the same field with (`FormulaCellRenderer`): `currency` when the summary declares its currency (`summaryDeclaresCurrency`, the cell's own predicate, now exported from `@object-ui/fields`), else `number` when `resolveFieldScale` answers a width, else the plain default as today. No second formatter: the existing currency arm (`formatCurrency`) and number arm (`resolveFieldScale`) do the formatting.

**Measured first, as the triage asked.** On a live showcase (`origin/main` d95ddebc, `objectstack dev`), `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_expense_report` serves the summary fields with their scale, e.g. `total_amount`: `{"type":"summary","scale":2,"summaryOperations":{"object":"showcase_expense_line","field":"amount","function":"sum"}}`, no `currencyConfig`. The source `showcase_expense_line.amount` is served as `type: currency` on its own object. So the scale reaches the console and the gap was the footer.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditConflictFields-33557.test.tsx`, new. The real `ObjectGrid`, `data-table` and `ConcurrentUpdateDialog`; writes go through the real `@object-ui/data-objectstack` adapter and `@objectstack/client`, with only `fetch` stubbed by a server answering a stale `If-Match` with the 409 `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` envelope. Cells are edited by click, typing and Enter, then the row's Save is clicked.
  - Two changed fields + a 409: the dialog lists two rows, `estimate_hours` under "Estimate" (61 / 77) and `owner_note` under "Owner note" (shipped / blocked), and its text holds no `{` or `}`.
  - CONTROL: one changed field shows no list, names "Estimate" and both values.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerSummaryFieldScale-33542.test.tsx`, new. The real `ObjectGrid` footer, its field catalogue read from the data source's object schema, under a real `I18nProvider`.
  - en: a summary with `scale: 2` totals to `Sum: 230,000.00`; zh-CN: `合计:230,000.00`.
  - en and zh-CN: a summary declaring a `fixed` CNY currency totals exactly as a plain currency column with the same config does (money, not a bare number).
  - CONTROL: a summary with no scale and no currency keeps the plain total (`Sum: 7`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Money follows the summary's own `currencyConfig`, not its source field's type** (seat accepted this reading). The card asks for the currency format "when its source field is currency". The spec's `currencyConfig` describe says "Absent: dynamic mode, and no currency on a summary", and the list cell (`FormulaCellRenderer`) draws a summary as money only when `summaryDeclaresCurrency` holds. The footer follows the same rule, so footer and cell agree. HotCRM's All Invoices `paid_amount` (`Field.summary`, `scale: 2`, no `currencyConfig`, summing currency `crm_payment.amount`) therefore totals as `230,000.00`, matching its cells; a HotCRM author who wants it drawn as money declares `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', ... }` on the summary. The HotCRM result is read from a fixture of the same shape in the pin above, not from a live HotCRM run.
- A `formula` column's footer total also falls to the plain default arm (the cell draws it by `returnType`). Not measured on a real producer here; noted only.
